@graph.name: Dazzle Vector Combat Training Shorts
@graph.description: Develop custom geometric MMA training shorts with a red drawcord, scalloped side openings and mesh lining. TONTON OEM/ODM sampling for brands, gyms and teams.
@graph.category: Custom MMA and grappling training shorts

mainEntity.name: Can you customize the stripe design and red drawcord?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Send authorized logos, geometric artwork, team colors, cord color, labels and packaging requirements. Approve panel placement and a physical sample before bulk production.

mainEntity.name: What is the fabric composition and weight?

acceptedAnswer.text: The reference is supplied as a lightweight stretch shell with a micro-dot mesh inner layer. Exact shell and mesh fiber percentages, GSM and stretch requirements are confirmed in the project specification; 92% polyester / 8% spandex and 140–160 GSM are not confirmed specifications for this item.

mainEntity.name: Does the mesh form a compression liner?

acceptedAnswer.text: The supplied images show a mesh inner layer and mesh at the hem. They do not establish a fitted compression-short liner. Confirm liner coverage, stretch and finish on the selected sample.

mainEntity.name: Can these shorts be used for competition?

acceptedAnswer.text: This is a training and product-development reference. External drawcords, split height, coverage and other details must be checked against the named event rules. Request a separate competition specification when needed.

mainEntity.name: Can we order matching rash guards?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Coordinated team-kit artwork can be developed with separate sizing and specifications for the rash guard and shorts. The top shown in model imagery is a styling reference and is not included in this shorts specification.

mainEntity.name: What is the MOQ and sampling process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selected custom projects start from 10 pieces; the applicable minimum depends on style, fabric, artwork, colorway and size allocation. Send your quantity, sizes, delivery country and target date for a written quotation and sample plan.
